valores.label: Top of the tilted carbonate platform (reconstructed elevation)

legenda: Reconstructed = the agency's estimate of where the layer once stood.
nota: "a tilted carbonate platform between (reconstructed) elevations of +1300 m and -4000 m" (relido). +1.300 m = +4.265 ft ("more than 4,000"); −4.000 m = −13.123 ft ("about 13,000"). Na tela, "+4,000 FT" sozinho arredondaria para baixo um "more than" (B14): MORE THAN +4,000 FT ou +4,265 FT.
licenca: domínio público (obra do governo federal dos EUA, 17 U.S.C. §105): o número vai recriado no visual do canal

pedidos.pedido: F44 (atribuído; S28): 'a tilted carbonate platform between (reconstructed) elevations of +1300 m and -4000 m' = +4.265 ft e −13.123 ft. Tela +4,265 FT / −13,123 FT (+1,300 M / −4,000 M) · USGS; a voz em pés.
